body:
a pattern i keep chasing across her eras: red turning to gold from Red onward, and then the "willow" video putting a real golden string in her hands — a wink straight back at "invisible string."

coincidence, or a map she drew years ahead? longlivets.com/?lens=easter-eggs&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=color-thread

Different subject from the day's other slots. Deliberately references song TITLES ('willow', 'invisible string') and the documented VISUAL easter egg (the golden string in the willow video) rather than quoting any lyric line, honoring the no-lyrics redline (docs/decisions.md 2026-07-09).
